diagnosis: The GetWireReceipt endpoint resolves wire transfer records solely by the transferID chi path parameter without checking if the requesting account matches the sender or recipient account. Attackers can view sensitive financial records including sender/receiver names, routing numbers, account numbers, and settlement amounts.

GET /transfers/tx_441829/receipt HTTP/1.1
Host: banking.fintech-core.net
Authorization: Bearer customer_session_token_331
Accept: application/json
